title: Chapter 1387
text:
As if seeing Han Xiao's confusion, the Realmless King explained in a deep voice, "One of my babies is pregnant.

"This secondary dimension is pregnant with one of my children. It is rather special. When it was taken away, it was still an embryo and has yet to take shape. The dimensional entities that took it away intend to eat it after it matures, so I hope that you can take it back under the premise of protecting that secondary dimension from shattering."

"So it's not your old … Cough, I'll try my best." Han Xiao coughed and asked, "By the way, what are the origins of those dimensional entities?"

The Realmless King changed his sitting posture and said slowly, "They're external entities.

"They are external dimensional entities. I was born in this region, and this is my territory. Originally, I was the only overlord level life form here, and I had no natural enemies or competitors. However, ever since those dimensional entities arrived here from the space storm, my situation changed. They set their sights on me and settled down at the edge of my territory. I tried many times to chase them away, but failed. However, they couldn't do anything to me …"

With the Realmless King's explanation, Han Xiao quickly understood the situation.

The secondary dimension world had an independent ecological model. Due to the unpredictability of space, the division of regions was usually based on certain special secondary dimensions or overlord life forms. For example, the territory controlled by the Realmless King was a representative stable region. The regions outside these regions were like the desolate universe belt of the main universe, but they were not desolate. Instead, they were filled with the unknown.

This was like a group of heroes, but the area was too vast, and the borders were unknown. Most of the stable regions did not know of each other's existence, nor did they want to be discovered by outsiders. After all, the environment here was more dangerous, and it was difficult to nurture civilization. The life forms that were born were more particular about the law of the jungle, where the strong preyed on the weak.

However, order would also be born from chaos. A small number of stable districts would communicate with each other. Due to different reasons, their names would spread out and connect with other stable districts. It was just like how primitive tribes in the Age of Desolation would discover each other, forming a new ecology of complex factions.

The Realmless King was a member of a composite ecosystem. He knew the coordinates of several stable regions and had always been safe.

To put it simply, the situation that the Realmless King encountered was like a local tyrant meeting a local tyrant. The secondary dimension was so big, but the other party refused to leave no matter what and even had designs on him. Thus, there was a neighbor dispute.

Han Xiao obtained the information of these few dimensional entities from the spiritual information shared by the other party. They were all summaries of the Realmless King's experience in fighting them over the years, displaying their various abilities.

However, this information only had a little reference value to him. As long as they really fought, he would be able to obtain more detailed information through the combat information on the interface. Han Xiao did not take the Realmless King's exaggerated description of the enemy because of his past impression to heart.

Although the secondary dimensions were bizarre, as long as no one reached a higher grade, the peak Beyond Grade As of the main universe were still the absolute predators at the top of the food chain. No matter how famous the Dimensional Gods were here, they would not be able to show off in front of him.

"I understand the situation. Send a projectile to go with me."

Han Xiao's tone was casual. With a sway of his body, a Lord's Avatar separated from his body. Surging Mechanical Force surged out of his body and poured into the Lord's Avatar, activating the Lord's Descent state.

He did not plan to leave this place. His main body would stay behind to keep an eye on the Realmless King in case he did anything. Sending the Lord's Avatar was enough to resolve this mission.

"Alright, if you don't mind, I hope to let him temporarily inherit my power. It will only be beneficial to him. Take it as a small apology."

The Realmless King raised an arm and waved it. Harrison spun and landed in front of Han Xiao. His eyelids trembled, and he slowly opened his eyes. He looked like he had just woken up from a coma.

As soon as he saw Han Xiao, Harrison's eyes quickly focused. He slowly recalled what happened before he fainted, and his face trembled in disbelief.

"Your Excellency Black Star?! I … I'm still alive? "

Han Xiao pressed down on Harrison's shoulder, and electric sparks appeared on his fingertips. He then looked at the interface and retracted his hand. He nodded calmly and said, "Your vital signs are all normal. It's good that you're fine."

"I still remember that the fleet was attacked … Did you come to save me?"

Harrison was touched.

He still remembered the last memory before he fainted. The overwhelming black tide swallowed the entire fleet, and the fleet did not resist at all. He did not have time to do anything. At that moment, he thought that he was finished. Jenny's beautiful face and shiny forehead flashed across his mind, and his heart was filled with reluctance and despair.

Now that he woke up and saw Han Xiao, Harrison's uneasy heart calmed down. His fear, panic, nervousness, and other emotions disappeared instantly. He knew that Black Star's arrival meant that he was fine.

Before he could ask for the reason, Harrison felt his body turn around involuntarily. At the same time, a mental message sounded in his mind.

"Kid, I'm the Realmless King. Relax your body and mind and accept my infusion."

As soon as he turned around, Harrison saw the strange scene of this dimension and the terrifying body of the Realmless Lord. An instinctive fear rose from the depths of his soul, like a chill spreading in his bone marrow, instantly freezing his body.

However, this feeling disappeared in the blink of an eye. If he was alone, Harrison felt that he might have gone crazy from fear. However, when he thought about how Black Star, this father-level universe powerhouse, was standing behind him, an incomparable sense of security immediately dispelled all the fear in his heart.

Without any fear, the explorer's soul was immediately ignited. Harrison looked at the Realmless King, and his tone unknowingly became filled with curiosity.

"Your Excellency Black Star, what is this thing?"

"He's not a thing. He's called the Realmless King, a life form from the secondary dimension. He's a waste collector." Han Xiao replied casually. Then, he patted Harrison's shoulder and said, "Listen to him. Relax and let it enter your body. It won't hurt."

As soon as he said that, the Realmless King blinked his eyes at the same time. Then, the black fog around him seemed to be pulled and surged toward Harrison, who was at a loss, and entered his body.

Very soon, black and red slender lines appeared on the surface of his body like protruding blood vessels, but they were in a mess and were still twisting irregularly. However, Harrison did not feel any pain. He only felt his body heat up.

In a place where he could not see, every cell in his body was being cleansed by the black fog-like energy, undergoing a benign mutation in the direction of optimization. Although he was still a low-level Super, his basic physical fitness was rapidly increasing.

After a long while, the black and red lines on Harrison's body converged on his chest and turned into a mark. This represented the contract formed by the Realmless King. With it, one could borrow the Realmless King's power in most environments.

Dimensional deities like this could project their power to life forms through contracts. This was also the main method they used to enter the main material universe. Some of the religious sects in the galaxy had connections with the dimensional deities, and the Mark of the Underworld on Han Xiao's body was similar.

The amount of power borrowed depended on the contractor's individual strength on one hand, and on the other hand, it depended on the level of the contract. On account of Han Xiao, the Realmless King had concluded a contract of the highest level. In a critical moment, the Realmless King could even temporarily take over and provide a 'grandpa substitute' service.

It was all thanks to him that Harrison was able to enjoy such treatment.

"F * ck, the Advanced Luck Glow is really …"

Han Xiao gritted his teeth in envy.

With his current level, he was already the source of luck for the owner of the Luck Glow. Because of his existence, Harrison was able to turn this danger into a fortuitous encounter.

If I could have met a backer like myself when I was weak, that would have been awesome!

Unfortunately, I've already reached my current height, and not many people are qualified to be relied on by me … Han Xiaoxin sighed.

At this moment, Harrison's eyes had already turned pure black. The Realmless King took over his body and nodded.

"I'm ready. Shall we set off now?"

Han Xiao nodded. He controlled the Lord's Avatar to take out the Dimension Travel vehicle and brought Harrison along. With a flash of light, they disappeared.

At this moment, he suddenly thought of something and took out the container that held Bobanica. "By the way, I caught this guy and forgot to return it to you."

The Realmless King glanced at the container with a human-like look of disdain in his eyes. "Keep it. Release it after you're done."

Han Xiao pursed his lips and put away the container. It seemed like this ball of liquid was indeed bragging when he said that he was the Realmless King's confidant.

The Lord's Avatar needed to travel for a while. Han Xiao rose and sat cross-legged in midair, floating at the same height as the Realmless King's head. The two of them stared at each other.

…

The Lord's Avatar set the dimensional coordinates provided by the Realmless King, and the vehicle traveled all the way. It did not take long for them to reach their destination.

This place was still a black secondary dimension, but unlike the doomsday-like scene at the Realmless King's side, the darkness here gave off a quiet and peaceful aura.

Han Xiao could sense that the energy of the entire secondary dimension was flowing to the same location, and in that direction, there was an incomplete life signal budding. The entire dimension was giving birth to something.

"This is the place. Those dimensional entities have been entrenched here. Be careful." The Realmless King sent a message through Harrison.

Han Xiao nodded. He opened the Dimensional Army Box and summoned the endless Mech Legion. At the same time, he activated a portion of the soldiers to fuse into a normal version of the Mechanical Deity and prepared for battle.

At this moment, a few powerful energy sources approached from different directions. Three huge figures that blotted out the sky approached from afar and quickly occupied their line of sight. They had different appearances, and they were the foreign dimensional deities that occupied this place. The moment they appeared, they brought with them a strong sense of oppression.

"Who is it?! How dare you disturb our … F * ck, Black Star! "

"We can't beat them. Run!"

The moment the three dimensional entities saw the Mechanical Deity, they immediately turned around and ran even faster than when they came.

Seeing this, Han Xiao and the Realmless King were stunned.

He thought that he was going to solve the problem, but he did not expect these dimensional entities to run away like frightened rabbits the moment they saw him. It was as if they really knew him.

Could it be that my name has really spread in the secondary dimension world?

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes as his thoughts raced.

These three dimensional entities are outsiders. Perhaps they came from somewhere near the surface … Could it be that when I was traveling with Ames a few decades ago, I accidentally beat up some dimensional deities who didn't realize that they were light bulbs, and that's why I became famous?!

Han Xiao thought about the reason, but his hands were not slow. The Mech Legion immediately chased after them.

These three dimensional entities could not even be dealt with by the Realmless King, and in his hands, it was only a one-sided abuse.

Han Xiao originally wanted to kill them, but since the other party knew him, he controlled his strength slightly and left them alive.

After a violent beating, the three dimensional entities sat in a row in front of him with bruises all over their faces.

"This …"

The Realmless King's face twitched. The situation was different from what he had imagined.

The powerful outsider that he could not chase away no matter how hard he tried was so cowardly that he ran away the moment he met Black Star. He could not even escape and was caught and beaten up. This made him feel a little disillusioned.

Seeing Black Star make a move with his own eyes, the Realmless King was afraid, but at the same time, he was glad that he did not use force. The top experts of the main material universe were indeed not to be trifled with.

While he was thinking, Han Xiao stood with his arms crossed, interrogating the three dimensional entities curiously.

"Where have the three of you heard of my name?"

"We … we've seen you kill dimensional deities …"

The three dimensional deities, who were strong enough to dominate a region in the secondary dimension world, became extremely docile and told him everything.

Han Xiao only realized that there was a reason why the three of them had come to the Realmless King's territory.

These three dimensional deities were originally stationed near the 'secondary dimension shallow layer' controlled by the three Universal Civilizations. Because there was a Universal Civilization expanding there, the three of them had long planned to migrate.

A few decades ago, when he and Ames were traveling, they passed by that area and beat up another dimensional deity. The three of them saw the tragic scene and were afraid, so they made up their minds to migrate and enter the depths of the secondary dimension. In the end, they came to the territory of the Realmless King many years ago. It was not easy for them to meet a lone deity, so they planned to eat the Realmless King before continuing forward.

However, the three of them did not expect that they would not be able to defeat the other party. They wanted to leave, but they coincidentally discovered this secondary dimension with a special embryo. They instinctively felt that eating this life would be beneficial to them, so they stayed.

"It's such a bad timing for this to happen."

The corner of Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he did not know what to say.

If this mission was done by anyone else, the difficulty would be in line with the high reward. Ordinary Beyond Grade As would basically be given nothing in front of the three dimensional entities. However, if it was him, he would not even need to make a move. This was how convenient it was to have high Reputation.

"Erm, we've told you everything we know. Can you let us go …"

A dimensional entity said carefully.

"Don't even think about it."

Han Xiao rejected without hesitation.

At this moment, the Realmless King could not help but say, "Black Star, this secondary dimension has been taken back. I'll occupy this place again first."

As he spoke, a black liquid substance emerged from his body, wanting to fill up this dimension and return it to his territory.

Han Xiao was about to agree when he suddenly paused and changed his mind. "Don't be in such a hurry. I want to see what the embryo looks like first."

"My child hasn't formed yet. Is there a need for that?"

"This is the first time I've seen such a phenomenon. I'm curious."

Han Xiao replied casually before turning around and flying toward the breeding ground. The Realmless King had no choice but to follow behind.

After advancing for a distance, Han Xiao saw a grayish-white sphere floating in the center of the secondary dimension. It was like a fog that was condensed together and then wrapped in a translucent membrane. Waves of energy surged in from all directions, nourishing this embryo.

In his perception, this embryo had an incomparably exuberant life force, as dazzling as dozens of stars.

Han Xiao took a closer look and saw that in the gray fog flowing in the membrane, there seemed to be a long figure flashing past like a dragon.

The Realmless King followed and said helplessly, "It's not born yet. What's there to see?"

Han Xiao ignored him and stroked the embryo. He realized that although the membrane was very thin, it was very tough.

At this moment, an item introduction popped up on the interface.

Han Xiao glanced at it and paused. Then, he slowly turned to look at the Realmless King with a faint smile.

"You said … this is your child?"

"What's wrong?" The Realmless King met Han Xiao's gaze and suddenly felt a little guilty.

"Bullsh * t. No wonder you took the risk to force me to help you snatch it back. So it's such a strange item … Are you betting that I won't discover the wonders of this thing?"

Han Xiao flicked the embryo with his finger, his teasing tone containing uncontrollable surprise as he grinned.

"It's ninety percent true and one percent false, right? I was almost fooled by you. "
